allowed_generic_rules.rule: Hide LE target files until scoring/gate stage.
Use LA as content donor and LE references for structure; avoid near-copy.
Require patch/function lineage and explainability artifacts.
allowed_generic_rules.notes: Supports replayable governance and PM audits.

allowed_generic_rules.rule: Run anti-copy/derivation checks and surface warnings as governance risk.
Enforce vendor include/API elimination with explicit mapping.
Keep runtime-sensitive unknowns in FAIL_CLOSED until evidence exists.
Use explicit source allowlists per variant and track forbidden sources.
Separate DT/schema alignment checks from runtime correctness claims.
allowed_generic_rules.notes: Avoids overclaiming from static schema alignment.

allowed_generic_rules.rule: Compile/checkpatch/gate must report NOT_RUN honestly when not executed.
Use LA/LE terminology consistently in plans, artifacts, and PM summaries.

explicit_rejections.reason: Audio codec analog/MBHC behavior is irrelevant to TLMM pinctrl.
SoundWire topology and identity logic do not apply to pinctrl drivers.
Amplifier subsystem behavior is non-transferable to TLMM pinctrl.
DAPM/control metrics are codec-specific and not relevant to pinctrl semantics.
Audio runtime checks are not valid for pinctrl pilot governance.

usage_policy_for_variant_c.allowed: Only ALLOW_GENERIC rules can influence non-audio Variant C behavior.
usage_policy_for_variant_c.forbidden: Any audio-specific behavioral rule transfer is disallowed.
